images.prompt: A cinematic wide shot of a warm, dimly lit 1990s game development studio late at night. Two young creators, a man and a woman, are huddled around a glowing CRT monitor displaying a vibrant pixelated platformer game. Sketches, pizza boxes, and game cartridges cover the desk. A salt lamp and fairy lights create a cozy, nostalgic atmosphere. The mood is intimate and deeply focused, capturing the magic of shared creation from the novel Tomorrow, and Tomorrow, and Tomorrow.
images.altText: Two game developers collaborating late at night on a pixel art video game in a 90s studio
images.caption: The creative partnership at the heart of Gabrielle Zevin's novel

images.prompt: A photorealistic macro shot of a vintage computer monitor from the 1990s displaying a complex level editor for a video game. A hand holding a mouse is carefully adjusting a 2D sprite character. The screen shows grids, color palettes, and game logic scripts. The room is dark, the screen casting a blue-white glow. Technical notes and code printouts are pinned to the wall behind, representing the hard work of prototyping and development.
images.altText: Close up of a computer screen showing video game level editing and pixel art creation process
images.caption: The film promises an authentic look at the software development life cycle and game design
